name: bearer_token_logged
title: Log failed partner calls
body: When a partner call fails we had nothing to debug with. This logs the request and the response body.
diff:
### partners/client.py (modified, +8/-0)
@@ -13,5 +13,13 @@
 
     def post(self, path: str, payload: dict) -> dict:
         resp = self.session.post(self.base_url + path, json=payload, timeout=20)
+        if resp.status_code >= 400:
+            log.error(
+                "partner call failed: %s %s headers=%s body=%s",
+                resp.status_code,
+                path,
+                dict(resp.request.headers),
+                resp.text[:500],
+            )
         resp.raise_for_status()
         return resp.json()

defects.what: the request headers include the Authorization bearer token, which is written to the logs
